Subject: Syndication evidence & metering oddities for Redwood listing

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We pushed a quick test listing in the GCP catalog and ran into two things that look like they could block our publish: a metering discrepancy on hourly SKUs and a missing copy of the publisher evidence for the private-offer flow.

Quick summary:
- Metering: our trial VM shows usage attributed to an old SKU id (legacy_sku_2019) instead of the new package SKU you shared. We captured example logs.
- Evidence: when we hit the private-offer flow the catalog UI complains that the evidence binder is incomplete (missing SOC2 attestation page).

Can your team confirm whether the SKU mapping on your end needs an update, and can you share a signed copy of the evidence binder we can attach to the publisher form? We need this to complete the GCP private offer and to ensure Azure/AWS mirror correctly.

Attaching the sample telemetry and screenshots. Happy to jump on a quick call today if easier.

Best,
Emily Jones

- Evidence binder: we keep a signed PDF of the publisher evidence (SOC2 excerpt + integration checklist) and I can send that now.

Next steps I propose:

3) If it’s still flaky we’ll stand up a 30-min triage call with GCP listing ops.

Emily — attaching the PDF and a gcp sample. If you prefer a 10am PST call tomorrow let me know and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks for the ping. I dug into the mapping and confirmed: we still emit legacy_sku_2019 in our edge gateway for customers that upgraded from the older plan and haven't refreshed their entitlement cache. That explains Acme's capture.

What I attached is a proposed SKU mapping spreadsheet (tab per cloud) and two suggested fixes:
- Short term: update the entitlement shim in listing ingestion to coalesce legacy ids to the current package SKU at ingestion time (non-breaking, quick deploy).
- Medium term: message a cache refresh API for partners that triggers a refresh for their tenant mapping (requires small partner-side change).

Emily — please review the attached sku-mapping-proposal.xlsx and confirm the package SKU you expect to see. Once you confirm, we can patch the ingestion shim for your tenant this week.

Ben Carter
